Exact algebraic simplification and partial fractions of both formal series
correctness.rationale: For each two-gram, subtract counts of its extensions on one side from its two-gram count to recover the indicator of the corresponding boundary two-gram. For n≥3 and m≥1 these boundaries determine u,v; 101 counts the interior single zeros and 000 counts exactly the excess zeros over length two. Conversely, the five allowed triple counts in the proof follow by counting the long gap ends (001 and 100), the short interior gaps (101), the ones with two zero neighbors (010) and the three-zero windows (000). The triple data and the boundaries recover all shorter counts. The all-zero word and lengths 0,1,2 are correctly separated. Choosing c of m−1 interior gaps to be long and distributing h among the r labeled long gaps gives precisely the binomial product, also checking realizability and the singleton condition. Independently simplified the geometric interior sum to z/[(1−z²)(1−z³)]. Allowing all h and removing excess when r=0 gives the stated C series; summing c=0, then c=m−1 with m=2 and m≥3 separately, gives the U series. Partial fractions give the stated parity formulas and small-length checks give the two listed first collisions. Independent replay compares the complete partitions, not just their sizes, through n=19. The zero-error claim follows by exactly one representative per profile.
residual_risks: The finite replay corroborates but does not replace the all-length argument. The complete profile includes endpoint information; the count does not transfer to pure unordered three-gram observations or cyclic words.

value.rationale: Forbidden-11 is a classical finite-state source. Exact capacity versus singleton counts distinguish choosing one codeword per observable profile from the stronger property that the full source word is uniquely identified. The quadratic versus linear growth and every-fiber binomial formula quantify both properties uniformly and enable exact finite-length ambiguity checks beyond a general Euler method or asymptotic growth bound.
residual_risks: Value is in the exact linear fixed-observation classification, not general reconstruction methodology or a claim about errors, missing reads, or long reads.
